title: The Needs you row says the review state

intent.outcome: A Needs you row carries the round spent of the budget and the open findings with their severities.
intent.problem: A human deciding whether to review a task with five open findings, two of them high, and the budget spent cannot see any of it.

in_scope: the Needs you row's second line
the review state derived from the rounds and the findings

acceptance_criteria.description: A row with open findings says how many are open and names the highest severity.
A row whose budget is spent says the round spent of the budget.

questions.question: Does the review state fit beside the age at forty columns?
